title: Statal passive (sein + Partizip II)
description: Learn about Statal passive (sein + Partizip II) in German.
explanation: The passive voice shifts focus to the action rather than who performs it. Formed with werden + Partizip II.

exercises.question: Das Haus ___ nächstes Jahr gebaut.
exercises.explanation: Wird + built (gebaut) forms the present passive.
